preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and 1 <= len(s) <= 100000 and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case string s has length between 1 and 100,000 and consists only of lowercase letters a-z.
The number of test case strings matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == sum((s[i:].count(p) + s[:len(s)-len(p)+1].count(p) if len(p) <= len(s) else 0) for p in all_substrings(s)) for i, s in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output line i contains the self-similarity value for test case i, defined as the sum over all nonempty substrings p of s of (occurrences of p in s) squared.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(output_lines[i]), int) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representation.
